scientific_integrity: The original density condition first appeared in May 2026; the October 2026 expansion is treated separately as a later directly relevant comparison, not as a May publication. No independent audit, external validation, or priority certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Covers all pairs of real exponents for two sets whose union is N; it does not classify disjoint partitions for positive exponents. The result assembles existing published cardinality/core arguments and preexisting alternating blocks into a quantified new consequence. Novelty depends on whether this elementary synthesis has been previously made; independent priority verification is needed.
title: Prescribed Diophantine densities for two covering sets of upper density one
